scope: Implement hardware-neutral live reservation/admission over physical pools: atomically admit one exact runtime manifest against current runtime observations and owner policy, issue bounded local leases, recheck at launch, and deterministically release without treating observations as reservations.
completion_condition: Atomic local physical-pool lease/admission code, launch-time recheck, deterministic release, portable concurrency/aliasing tests, CLI/docs/ADR/validation are committed and CI is recorded.
next_step: Build an in-process atomic lease manager keyed by physical pool, consume exact runtime-manifest preparation peaks, intersect with current observed availability and owner policy, then require a fresh matching observation before launch.
instructions: No distributed transport or remote locking in this slice. Leases are local process control-plane state only. Shared/unified pools are charged once by pool ID. A successful lease does not imply model correctness, GPU qualification or executable distributed inference.
